newsitem.title: TANZANIA: SOCCER-WEAH SAYS HE WILL STAY WITH AC MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEAH SAYS HE WILL STAY WITH AC MILAN.

text.p: Liberian striker George Weah says AC Milan have no plans to release him at the end of the season.
"I'll stay at Milan at the end of the season -- I'm not moving out," Weah told the Tanzania Guardian newspaper in an interview published on Saturday.

The Italian club's coach Arrigo Sacchi had been reported as saying after the team's poor performance in the European champions' league that he would put several players up for sale at the end of the season.
"I'm not in that list -- I'm not lined up for sale," said Weah. The striker was in Tanzania for Liberia's African Nations' Cup qualifier against Taifa Stars on Saturday in Dar es Salaam.
